claims.statement: Behavior that the intent does not describe must not change.

hypotheses.title: tenant_skus misses SKUs added after import
hypotheses.suspected_behavior: After cart is imported, adding a new tenant or SKU to demo_shop.pricing._PRICES is invisible to head because _TENANT_SKUS was snapshotted at import; e.g. adding _PRICES['__new_tenant__']={'SKU-NEW-1': 1.0} then tenant_skus('__new_tenant__') misses it.
hypotheses.expected_base: ['SKU-NEW-1'] (sorted keys of the newly added tenant entry)
hypotheses.expected_head: [] (tenant unknown at import time, snapshot miss)
hypotheses.test_intent: Import demo_shop.cart then demo_shop.pricing, add a fresh tenant key with one SKU to pricing._PRICES, call cart.tenant_skus for that tenant and assert it equals sorted(pricing._PRICES[tenant]); base passes, head returns [].
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: If head tenant_skus returns the late-added SKUs matching base after _PRICES is mutated post-import, this hypothesis is wrong.

reasons: H1 was not tested: tenant_skus misses SKUs added after import.
